name: Asagao Kinema
description: A cinematic, editorial and elegant events theme for a one-screen independent cinema in a fictional town. Night-plum pages, dusk-plum bands, pale house-light text and one muted lilac for rules, numerals and dates; Piazzolla for headings over Libre Franklin. The hero and the stills are risograph duotone illustrations (raster WebP; two inks, grain, slight misregistration). Every page opens with a masthead (H5): the cinema's name large, a dateline row 'Programme 14 · Oct 13 to 19' and the menu below. The home page is a chaptered scroll of the week (L12): Monday to Sunday, each day a date numeral, a still, the film, a note and screening times, then tickets beside the foyer, membership and the journal. The footer is split in two tones (F10): tickets and prices on one side, the visit details and sitemap on the other. Pages: Programme, Visit & tickets, Membership, About, Journal, Newsletter and Contact. The programme, the ticket prices and the dateline are synced patterns, edited once.

summary.de: Eine Website für ein Programmkino mit einem Saal: Risografie-Illustrationen in zwei Farben und ein Spielplan Tag für Tag.

deviation: Codes: none (H5 + F10 + L12 as planned; combination unused). Neighbours: Yoru Chocolate (H3/F1/L11, red dark) and Tsuba Millinery (H12/F3/L14, pink light) share no code or palette family. Palette as planned (night plum #1E1A22, dusk plum #2C2731, pale #E8E3E6, muted lilac #8C7896 for rules, numerals and large type only, 4.2:1) plus soft lilac #B9A8C2 for small links (7.6:1 on night), ash #A69FA8 for quiet text and seat #252029; the visit half of the footer is pale with deep plum #4B3A55 links. Fonts verified against google/fonts OFL.txt: Piazzolla and Libre Franklin are OFL-1.1 without a Reserved Font Name; shipped as unmodified upstream variable TTFs. Industry independent cinema is new. Visual style risograph duotone: 4 raster illustrations (WebP, Grok Build image_gen via scripts/grok-image.sh), checked by eye for text and logos. Built from the Hogusu Physio skeleton (importer, synced-pattern helper, templates); the programme, ticket prices and dateline are synced patterns.
